title: Checkout Evolution Roadmap
summary: Decompose checkout expansion into bounded payment, confirmation, and policy SPEC candidates.

candidates.title: Card Payment Foundation
candidates.requirements_source:
# Card payment

- Authorize one card payment idempotently.
- Preserve the public checkout response envelope.

candidates.title: Accessible Checkout Confirmation
candidates.requirements_source:
# Confirmation

- Present a keyboard-accessible success state.
- Display the canonical participation identifier.

candidates.title: Payment Retry Policy
candidates.requirements_source:
# Retry policy

Define retry eligibility after product chooses ownership and retry limits.

coverage.title: Card payment behavior
coverage.rationale: The payment foundation owns authorization behavior.

coverage.title: Accessible confirmation
coverage.rationale: The confirmation candidate owns the presentation contract.

coverage.title: Retry policy decision
coverage.rationale: The candidate is explicit, but product policy blocks specification.

coverage.title: Shared idempotent checkout contract
coverage.rationale: Payment owns the durable contract and confirmation consumes its identifier.

gaps.title: Retry ownership and limits
gaps.detail: Product has not chosen automatic versus user-triggered retry or a maximum attempt count.
gaps.impact: Payment retry behavior cannot be specified without inventing policy.
